listings.mrt_info: 2 min (190 m) from NE16 Sengkang MRT Station

agent_evaluation.summary: A genuinely strong 2BR investment case: a 1001 sqft unit listed at $1,558 psf is ~11% under the URA median of $1,747.5 in a development sitting 190m from Sengkang MRT/hub. Keppel Land build, 622 units, deep resale liquidity (184 txns) and 7.3% resale-only CAGR. The standout of this batch.
agent_evaluation.rating_rationale: $1,558 psf vs $1,747.5 URA median = clear discount on a generously sized 1001 sqft 2BR (efficient $/unit at $1.56M, in the liquid sub-$1.6M band). 7.3% resale-only appreciation on 184 transactions is high-confidence. 190m to Sengkang MRT interchange + Compass One mall is best-in-class connectivity for the district. Reputable developer (Keppel Land), large 622-unit base for liquidity. Top technical frontier score (911). Only mild caveat: unit is large for a 2BR so per-sqft rent dilutes yield slightly.
red_flags: Large 1001 sqft footprint for a 2BR dilutes psf-rent yield versus a compact unit
OCR/D19 baseline appreciation is lower than RCR; sustained 7.3% partly reflects a strong recent cycle
catalysts: Direct 190m access to Sengkang MRT interchange + Compass One / Sengkang Grand Mall hub
Discount to URA median leaves room for mean-reversion upside
Buangkok/Sengkang continued HDB-upgrader demand keeps deep buyer pool
agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Strong tenant pool — directly atop a major NEL interchange and mall, appealing to families and commuters to CBD; large 1001 sqft 2BR commands a rent premium in absolute terms even if psf-yield is moderate.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: 7.3% resale-only CAGR on 184 transactions is reliable and the listing's discount to median supports continued upside; expect mid-single-digit forward appreciation rather than a repeat of the full historical rate.

listings.mrt_info: 6 min (500 m) from CC8 Dakota MRT Station

agent_evaluation.summary: Strong fundamentals on paper — D14 RCR location 500m from Dakota MRT, $1,795 psf is ~16% under the $2,144 URA median, low $1.35M entry. But field reviews flag Paya Lebar Airbase military-jet noise and reportedly poor inter-floor insulation/cracking, which cap the verdict. A location-led Neutral, not a clean buy.
agent_evaluation.rating_rationale: The discount (16% below $2,144 median) and Dakota MRT/Old Airport Road lifestyle pull are real positives, and 5.3% resale CAGR on 144 txns is solid mid-pack. But multiple resident reviews cite unbearable F-15/F-16/C-130 military jet noise from Paya Lebar Airbase (weekday + Saturday daytime) and poor build quality — thin floor slabs, wall cracks. These are exactly the qualitative risks the data can't price and they directly weigh on tenant retention and resale. Airbase relocation is a long-dated catalyst (post-2030), not near-term.
red_flags: Paya Lebar Airbase military jet noise reported as severe by residents (daytime weekdays + Saturdays)
Reported poor build quality: wall cracks and thin inter-floor insulation
$1,795 psf is high in absolute terms for a 752 sqft 99LH unit despite the median discount
catalysts: 500m to Dakota MRT (Circle Line) plus Old Airport Road food/lifestyle belt
Paya Lebar Central commercial transformation (long-dated)
Airbase relocation (post-2030) would eventually remove the noise overhang
agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Decent tenant demand from CCL connectivity and the Old Airport Road lifestyle draw, but jet noise is a known tenant deterrent that can lengthen vacancy and compress achievable rent.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: 5.3% resale CAGR is respectable; the median discount gives some cushion, but the noise/build reputation likely keeps this trailing cleaner D14/D15 RCR peers until the airbase moves.

listings.mrt_info: 15 min (1.26 km) from NE14 Hougang MRT Station

agent_evaluation.summary: Low $1.26M entry with a headline 8.2% URA CAGR and a real future catalyst — the Cross Island Line Defu station is being built nearby, giving this currently MRT-poor (1.26km to Hougang) Sim Lian project its first close rail link. But the appreciation rests on a thin 82-transaction base and the unit is far from existing MRT today, so it's a Buy-leaning Neutral.
agent_evaluation.rating_rationale: Positives: cheapest absolute price in the batch at $1.26M, $1,603 psf priced right at the URA median (fair, not overpaying), and the CRL Defu station is a concrete catalyst that would transform connectivity for a project that is currently a 1.26km walk to Hougang NEL. Negatives: 8.2% CAGR is the headline number but on only 82 transactions (lower confidence than the 144-292 txn peers here), Sim Lian build with no insulation standout, and until Defu opens (~2030) it remains effectively MRT-distant, which limits today's tenant pool. Catalyst is real but multi-year.
red_flags: Currently 1.26km from nearest MRT (Hougang) — weak existing connectivity
Appreciation rate rests on a thin 82-transaction sample (lower reliability)
Sim Lian build with no standout quality credentials; reviews note incomplete noise insulation
catalysts: Cross Island Line Defu station under construction nearby — first close rail link, ~2030
Sub-$1.3M entry is among the most affordable 2BR private options in D19
Priced at URA median (no overpayment) leaves catalyst upside intact
agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Modest today given the 1.26km MRT walk; the Defu CRL station is the key to unlocking stronger tenant demand, but that uplift is years out.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: 8.2% historical CAGR is real but thinly supported; forward case hinges on CRL Defu de-risking — treat as a catalyst play, not a proven trend.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: Discounted from 8.2% URA headline for thin 82-txn sample; mid-single-digit base with CRL Defu optionality

listings.mrt_info: 9 min (780 m) from CR11 Ang Mo Kio MRT Station

agent_evaluation.summary: A large 1130 sqft 2BR in Ang Mo Kio (D20) at just $1,416 psf — ~9% under the $1,557 URA median — near Ang Mo Kio MRT (780m, future CRL interchange). Big, low-psf, established-estate value play with 6.5% resale CAGR. Tempered by 21-year age and reported below-par estate maintenance, but a solid Buy.
agent_evaluation.rating_rationale: $1,416 psf is the lowest in the batch and ~9% below the $1,557 median for a spacious 1130 sqft layout — a strong value/$-per-sqft proposition for D20's deep owner-occupier estate. Ang Mo Kio is a mature town with Cross Island Line interchange (CR11) coming, 780m walk. 6.5% resale CAGR on 88 txns is solid. 579 units gives reasonable liquidity. Drags: built 2005 (21 yrs old, ~74 yrs lease left) and resident reviews flag mediocre maintenance and heavy-handed management — manageable but real for a hold/resale.

Resident reviews cite below-par estate maintenance and restrictive management
Thin 88-transaction appreciation sample
catalysts: Ang Mo Kio becomes a Cross Island Line interchange (CR11) — connectivity uplift

Established AMK estate with deep, stable owner-occupier demand
agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Steady family-tenant demand in a mature town near MRT; the generous 1130 sqft size rents well in absolute terms to families, though psf-yield is moderate.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: 6.5% resale CAGR plus a sub-median entry and CRL interchange catalyst support continued mid-single-digit appreciation; lease decay is the main forward drag.

listings.mrt_info: 11 min (920 m) from CR9 Serangoon North MRT Station

agent_evaluation.summary: The cheapest psf in the batch ($1,118) for a huge 1163 sqft 2BR at $1.3M, ~6% under the $1,185.5 URA median, with a future CRL Serangoon North station 920m away. Far East/Sino build with decent reviews. But it's 26 years old (~73 yrs lease) — the lease-decay and financing question caps it at Neutral.
agent_evaluation.rating_rationale: Value is the whole thesis: $1,118 psf and a 1163 sqft footprint give the lowest entry-cost-per-sqft here, below the $1,185.5 median, and the 7.6% resale CAGR (131 txns) is well-supported. CRL Serangoon North (CR9, 920m) is a genuine future catalyst and Far East/Sino is a reputable builder with 7.1/10 resident ratings. The counterweight is age — built 2000, ~73 years of lease left and accelerating decay, which weakens financing for future buyers and is the main reason resale liquidity could thin over a 5-7yr hold. Big and cheap, but the lease clock and dated fittings keep it balanced.

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Adequate family rental at a low absolute rent; older fittings and current lack of MRT keep it a price-led rather than premium rental.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: 7.6% historical CAGR is real, but lease decay from a 2000-build base is a structural headwind; CRL is the offsetting catalyst — net expect moderating, not sustained high, appreciation.

listings.mrt_info: 8 min (670 m) from TE25 Tanjong Katong MRT Station

agent_evaluation.summary: A brand-new (2026 TOP) CDL/MCL D15 project 670m from the new TEL Tanjong Katong station, with the listing's $2,549 psf sitting ~7% below the $2,746 project median — a sub-median entry on a quality launch. But the 11.3% CAGR carries explicit new-launch bias, the compact 667 sqft unit costs $1.7M at a steep absolute psf, and most price-in already happened. Honest Neutral.
agent_evaluation.rating_rationale: Quality is not the issue — CDL/MCL are top-tier developers, 638 units, prime D15 Katong, 670m to the new Thomson-East Coast Line Tanjong Katong station, and at $2,549 psf the listing is meaningfully under the $2,746 median (motivated/early sub-sale). The investment caution is value: the flagged has_new_launch_bias means the 11.3% figure reflects developer-led launch-to-now pricing, not a repeatable resale trend (rubric warns against importing this). At $2,549 psf for a small 667 sqft 2BR, much of the East Coast/TEL upside is already in the price; entry is high-absolute ($1.7M) and yield is thin at this psf. Good building, fully-priced entry.

listings.mrt_info: 6 min (510 m) from EW21 Buona Vista MRT Station

Anchored to the One-North research/tech employment hub with steady 5.3% resale CAGR. Smaller 334-unit development is the main liquidity caveat, but location quality earns a Buy.
agent_evaluation.rating_rationale: Location is the thesis: 510m to Buona Vista MRT (EW/CC interchange) directly serving the One-North research, biomedical and tech employment cluster plus NUS/Star Vista — a deep, durable tenant catchment that supports rent and resale. $1,605 psf is ~10% under the $1,792 median, a fair-to-good entry for D05 RCR. 5.3% resale CAGR (114 txns) is reliable. Caveats: only 334 units (smaller, thinner resale than the mega-developments here) and UEL is a mid-tier developer; reviews note in-block renovation noise and modest facilities. On balance the employment-anchored location and median discount outweigh these.

Drawbacks: 1.06km to Serangoon MRT (no near-station premium) and it is the one off-frontier listing here (slightly below the efficient set). Liquidity + quality outweigh the walk.

listings.mrt_info: 9 min (710 m) from SE4 Kangkar LRT Station

But it's served only by Kangkar LRT (no MRT), reviews flag space inefficiency, and connectivity is its structural ceiling — a value-led Neutral.
agent_evaluation.rating_rationale: Positives: cheapest entry here ($1.2M), $1,359 psf is ~8% below the $1,483 median, the development is large (928 units) and reasonably young (2016) with healthy 228-txn liquidity and 6.0% resale CAGR. The decisive negative is location: the only rail access is Kangkar LRT (710m), one stop on the Sengkang loop — there is no nearby MRT, which structurally caps tenant pool and resale appeal versus MRT-served D19 peers, and reviews note inefficient/wasteful layouts. Cheap and liquid, but the connectivity ceiling keeps it balanced rather than a buy.

listings.mrt_info: 15 min (1.25 km) from EW23 Clementi MRT Station

agent_evaluation.summary: A recent (2023) D05 mega-development (1,468 units, SingHaiyi) where this 893 sqft 2BR at $1,679 psf is dramatically below the $2,307 project median — but that gap is mostly because the median is inflated by newer/smaller higher-psf stock and new-launch pricing (flagged), so it is not a clean ~27% discount. Strong liquidity and a resale-only 5.2% CAGR; the 1.25km MRT walk and value-realism cap it at a measured Buy.
agent_evaluation.rating_rationale: Genuine strengths: one of the largest, most liquid developments in Singapore (1,468 units, 632 URA txns) in employment-rich D05 near One-North/NUS/Clementi, completed 2023 (fresh, minimal lease decay), top technical score (905). The resale-only CAGR of 5.2% (the rubric's honest figure, stripping the new-launch bias flagged in the data) is a sound RCR-grade number. The $1,679 psf looks far under the $2,307 median, but I'm not treating that as a 27% bargain — the median is skewed by smaller higher-psf and launch-priced units, so this is 'fairly priced for its size,' not a steal. The 1.25km walk to Clementi MRT is a real connectivity limiter for a $1.5M ticket. Net: quality, liquidity and freshness earn a Buy, but a measured one — not Strong Buy.

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Strong, durable tenant demand from NUS, One-North and the western jobs corridor; extensive mega-condo facilities aid leasing, though the MRT walk slightly trims commuter appeal.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Use the resale-only ~5.2% CAGR as the honest base — a solid RCR-grade rate; freshness and liquidity support continued steady appreciation rather than outsized gains given the already-elevated entry psf.
